note: Synced-workspot pairs for AI Spots. 'arrangements[].o' is [x, y, z, yaw] of the partner spot in this spot's local frame; yaw is degrees. src: authored = this workspot's own workSyncAnimClip.syncOffset, authoredInverse = the inverse of the partner's, measured = read off shipped sector placements, scene = read off the workspot instances of a shipped scene. n = shipped pairs observed at that arrangement. An identity offset with n = 0 means no shipped placement backs it, so the second spot has to be placed by hand.
